tier.description: This install's trust tier for its owner (tasks/net-teleport-spec.md 4.1); absent -> own.

replicas.description: tasks/m32n-spec.md D2: one in-process native replica per GPU; exactly one of device_uuid and replicas, exactly two replicas with unique devices and device_uuids that together are scheduler.devices (semantic rules).

kv_pool_tokens.description: tasks/m25-spec.md D4: absent or 0 = derived pool; otherwise a multiple of 64 and >= max_context_tokens (semantic rule); the executor bounds it above.

prefix_state_slots.description: tasks/m210-spec.md D6 (cere_model_desc.prefix_state_slots): device state slots of the native prefix cache; absent or 0 = cache off; at most CERE_MAX_PREFIX_STATE_SLOTS.

prefix_end_state.description: tasks/m210-spec.md D15''''' stage 2a (cere_model_set_prefix_end_state): drafting PREFILLs also capture their end state (class-pinned resume); requires prefix_state_slots > 0; absent or false = off (skipped, so config_hash is unchanged).

prefix_alt_edges.description: tasks/m210-spec.md D17 (cere_model_set_prefix_alt_edges): a session whose path runs through another session's edge over other KV pages stores its states on an alternative edge over its own pages instead of being refused (M210S-39); requires prefix_state_slots > 0; absent or false = off (skipped, so config_hash is unchanged).

sidecar_deadline_ms.description: Audit N1: the longest one tokenizer sidecar call (request write plus reply) may take before the child is killed, in milliseconds; absent or 0 = 120000 (skipped, so config_hash is unchanged).

reserve_output_tokens.description: tasks/sessions-spec.md SE-09: output tokens a generation's first session reserves (64-token multiple; 0 = its whole budget); needs preempt.

host_share_dir.description: O47 (tasks/build-loop-ple.md): absent = private HOST_PINNED block; an absolute host tmpfs directory without commas where the executor shares the artifact's HOST_PINNED region across native processes.

keep_host_share.description: tasks/m216-spec.md L4: true = the last detach of this process never unlinks the published O47 segment, so the next start attaches; requires host_share_dir.

speculative_draft_tokens.description: tasks/m29-spec.md D11: MTP draft tokens per speculate round (the verify window: the unfed token plus window - 1 drafts); absent or 0 = off, 4 = on (non-zero exactly when the profile declares native_speculative_batch). Family inkling2_loop takes a window of 2..8 instead of 4 (tasks/inkling-spec.md D-I-S9B: 1..7 drafts of the MTP drafter's block); scripts/cere_contracts.py checks the value per family.

levers.description: tasks/m23-spec.md PI-02: the deployment's lever selection, lever name -> implementation id; absent levers keep the registry default. Names, ids and their rules come from the lever registry (crates/cere-runtime/src/levers.rs, tests/fixtures/lever_registry.json; scripts/cere_contracts.py checks them). drafter replaces the former spec_drafts key.

lever_hot_swap.description: tasks/m23-spec.md PI-04: dev/bench only; true admits POST /v1/cere/levers (hot levers between requests). No committed profile sets it.

family.description: SelfTune ST4 S3a: the model family the executor library is built for (its descriptor's model_type). Absent = qwen4_exp (not serialized, so configs keep their config_hash); sdar (DICE-8B) runs every lever at its default and refuses speculation, decode rows > 1, the prefix cache, snapshots, preemption, LoRA, research, the lever hot swap and a hip device by name. inkling2_loop (Inkling 2 Mini, tasks/inkling-spec.md D-I5) refuses the same keys except decode rows > 1 and a Vulkan device.

ab.description: tasks/ab-split-spec.md AB-01: live A/B split of the runtime-layer levers (dev/experiments; absent in every shipped profile). A request's arm is a salted HMAC-SHA256 of its session key mapped onto the weights; each arm's levers go over the active set for that request only. Arm levers must be registered runtime-layer levers at bit_identical implementations (scripts/cere_contracts.py checks them against the lever registry); arm ids are unique and the weights sum above 0.

salt.description: Keys the session hash (a label, not a secret); a new salt reshuffles every session.

id.description: The arm id, the only name GET /v1/cere/stats reports.

weight.description: The arm's share of new sessions; 0 takes none.

levers.description: Runtime-layer lever name -> bit_identical implementation id; absent levers keep the request's active set.

loop_guard.description: tasks/loop-guard-spec.md: the native repetition guard (absent in every shipped profile = off). LG-D1: a running output whose text ends with at least min_repeats exact copies of a min_period_bytes..max_period_bytes unit covering min_span_bytes finishes with finish_reason "repetition". LG-D2: a conversation ending in tool_repeat_run identical assistant tool call -> tool result pairs is refused 400 loop_detected. Absent keys take their defaults; 0 turns a detector off and a table with both off is refused; with LG-D1 on, min_period_bytes <= max_period_bytes and min_repeats x max_period_bytes <= 65536 (checked in config.rs and scripts/cere_contracts.py).

min_period_bytes.description: LG-D1: the shortest repeating unit in output bytes; shorter periods (=====, 0, 0, 0) are never flagged. Default 16.

max_period_bytes.description: LG-D1: the longest repeating unit checked. Default 1024.

min_repeats.description: LG-D1: consecutive copies ending the output; 0 = LG-D1 off. Default 4.

min_span_bytes.description: LG-D1: bytes the copies cover together. Default 512.

tool_repeat_run.description: LG-D2: identical tool call -> result pairs ending the conversation that refuse the request; 0 = LG-D2 off. Default 10.

ignore_arg_keys.description: LG-D2: top-level argument keys left out of the call comparison. Default ["description"].

executor_memory_limit_bytes.description: tasks/m29-spec.md M29S2-02 (ledger M1): the executor device-byte limit; absent = 80 GiB. A whole MiB, at least 80 GiB and at most 86,432 MiB (tasks/m23-spec.md P8: GPU0 total - desktop baseline - the 10,240 MiB free floor).

decode_rounds_per_prefill_chunk.description: O79 (tasks/m210-spec.md PF1, cere_executor_set_decode_rounds): decode rounds after each prefill chunk while decode rows are ready; absent = 1 (the kinds alternate).

lora.description: Track LoRA (-v50): PEFT LoRA adapters on the base model, loaded and unloaded at runtime through POST /v1/load_lora_adapter and POST /v1/unload_lora_adapter (docs/API.md). The single form only (refused with replicas and with a federation worker of the entry). Absent in every other profile.

max_adapters.description: Adapters resident at once (CERE_LORA_MAX_ADAPTERS = 64); the executor reserves the pool at load.

adapter_root.description: Absolute directory every adapter path must resolve inside (symlinks resolved).

preload.description: Adapters loaded before the backend reports ready; at most max_adapters, unique names.

name.description: The served name: the request's model and a /v1/models id.

path.description: The PEFT directory (adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors) inside adapter_root.

research.description: WeightLab (-v57, tasks/weightlab-spec.md WL-01): opt-in capture and intervention plans bound to client scopes through the operator routes /v1/cere/research/* (docs/API.md "Research (WeightLab)"). cered also refuses max_capture_bytes_per_request above host_buffer_bytes, the bind port 18080, a device_uuid equal to the GPU1 production marker's and an unset [auth] operator_token_env. Dev only; absent in every other profile.

device_staging_bytes.description: Device capture staging, reserved at model create and counted in fits() against the memory budget (1 MiB..1 GiB).

host_buffer_bytes.description: The pinned host capture ring shared by every request (1 MiB..16 GiB); a request that cannot reserve its bound is 503 research_buffer_full.

max_capture_bytes_per_request.description: A plan whose capture bound exceeds this is refused at registration (400 research_budget_exceeded); at least 4096, at most host_buffer_bytes.

max_plans.description: Registered plans at once (CERE_RESEARCH_MAX_PLANS = 64); past it 507 research_plans_full.

max_vectors.description: Uploaded vectors at once; past it 507 research_vectors_full.

prefill_slice_ms.description: MixedPD (tasks/mixed-pd-spec.md, cere_executor_set_prefill_slice): layer-sliced prefill, a prefill call pauses at a layer boundary after about this many ms while decode rows are ready; absent = every call runs whole.

decode_share_pct.description: S1 G4 (tasks/beat-sglang-spec.md, cere_executor_set_decode_share): decode share, while two or more prompts wait they prefill back to back; with one left, decode rows get this percent of its prefill wall time; absent = the decode rounds per chunk stay.

prefill_age_calls.description: BC4 (b) (tasks/batch-concurrency-spec.md, cere_executor_set_prefill_age): the aging cap of the fewest-tokens-left prefill order; a prompt overtaken this many times by younger prompts' prefill calls runs next; absent = the executor default 8.

max_blob_bytes.description: NetTeleport S1: the largest state image /v1/cere/state/export and /import move (tasks/net-teleport-spec.md 4.3); absent -> 4294967296.

busy_wait_ms.description: NetTeleport S1: how long a state export or import waits for an idle executor before it refuses state_busy (D-T1); absent -> 30000.

park_on_stop.description: NetTeleport S3 (L1 warm restart): park the recent sessions' prefix states sealed under <ledger.state_dir>/parked/ at a graceful stop and import them at the next start; native_cuda single form only; absent -> false.

park_max_sessions.description: NetTeleport S3: how many recent distinct prompts the recorder keeps and a stop parks at most; absent -> 8.

park_max_bytes.description: NetTeleport S3: the image bytes one stop parks at most; absent -> 17179869184.

park_deadline_ms.description: NetTeleport S3: how long a stop parks after the drain, most recent session first; absent -> 10000.

clients.description: Roadmap v0.7 A2: the rules that label each chat request with a client and a workload in its log lines and GET /metrics; first match wins, none -> `other` (crates/cere-runtime/src/labels.rs).

batch_floor.description: Team pools (tasks/net-teleport-spec.md 4.4, C17): the share of grants batch keeps while both classes wait; absent -> 0.1.

owner_wait_cap_ms.description: Team pools (Q-T6, Q-T8): a non-owner job on an owned worker ends within this long of its grant; absent -> 120000.

allowed_tiers.description: Tiers this person's state and work may go to (tasks/net-teleport-spec.md 4.1, Q-T5); absent -> ["own"].

token_envs.description: Team pools (C14): env vars of this person's further device tokens; each authenticates as this scope. Absent -> token_env only.

class.description: Team pools (C17): the class of this scope's requests without X-Cere-Class; absent -> interactive.

per_scope_inflight.description: Team pools (C18): this scope's in-flight cap instead of admission.per_scope_inflight; at most admission.max_backend_inflight.

max_sessions_per_scope.description: Team pools (C18): this scope's live-session cap instead of ledger.max_sessions_per_scope.

max_batch_inflight.description: Team pools (C18, Q-T7): this person's cap on in-flight batch requests; absent -> only the scope cap.

operator_token_env.description: Name of the env var holding the operator bearer token (M3.5 Q13); absent -> operator routes disabled. Must differ from every scope token_env.

keyless_scope.description: The configured scope a client request without an Authorization header belongs to (tasks/g9-prod-spec.md F2); a present header must still name a token; operator routes unchanged. Absent -> every client request needs a bearer.

evict_terminal_when_full.description: OH-03: a full ledger evicts its oldest terminal record instead of rejecting ledger_full; absent = false.

usage.description: tasks/net-teleport-spec.md 4.4 (S7): the usage journal in <ledger.state_dir>/usage/. Every key optional.

enabled.description: Write one usage row per request terminal; absent -> true.

retention_days.description: Days of usage day files kept, today included (Q-T9); absent -> 90.

federation.description: M3.5 federation (tasks/m35-spec.md Q16). Timings default to configs/cluster/dev-tailnet.yaml control_plane.

listen.description: <ip>:<port>; host a literal in 100.64.0.0/10 or a loopback literal, never a wildcard; checked by the semantic rules.

ca_file.description: Absolute PEM path outside any repository checkout and not under the state dir; --check-config checks the shape only.

cert_file.description: Absolute PEM path outside any repository checkout and not under the state dir; --check-config checks the shape only.

key_file.description: Absolute PEM path outside any repository checkout and not under the state dir; --check-config checks the shape only.

endpoint.description: https://<literal 100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8 or [::1] address>:<port 1..65535>; checked by the semantic rules.

principal.description: The worker's mTLS principal; unique and not the coordinator's.

owner.description: Team pools (tasks/net-teleport-spec.md 4.4, C15): the auth scope owning this worker; absent -> unowned.

tier.description: This worker's trust tier for everyone but its owner (4.1, C13; own for the owner); absent -> own.

owner_only.description: Team pools (C19): owner-only windows "<days> <HH:MM>-<HH:MM> <zone>", e.g. "Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 Europe/Berlin" (days Mon..Sun, ranges or comma lists; start before end; zone UTC or an IANA name in the system database); needs owner.

expect.description: Inventory pins checked before Ready (M3.5 Q10).
